narr: Severe thunderstorms across Laramie and Niobrara Counties produced severe hail over 1 inch in diameter. For the Laramie County storm, prolonged training and heavy rain produced flash flooding across portions of the city of Cheyenne with hail accumulating to depths of several inches deep. An NWS employee on the north side of town noted animal loss from the hail and a greenhouse damaged by the wind driven hail.
ev: Heavy rain from severe thunderstorms inundated drainage system in Cheyenne causing localized flooding along Dell Range and Ridge Road.
Flooding reported under the Ames underpass of the Union Pacific Railroad tracks prompting closure of the road.
